courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 預力混凝土孔道灌漿
related.transfer: 可遷移「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」與「全橋鋼腱普查與抽樣」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預力混凝土孔道灌漿的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Load path of external tendons" and "Network-wide tendon survey and sampling" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Prestressing-duct grouting must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在維持交通下安全移除腐蝕外置鋼腱、重建預力並留下可追溯的鋼腱履歷；預力混凝土孔道灌漿則以以灌漿材料、孔道與排氣配置、灌漿程序與空洞檢測，確保後拉預力鋼腱數十年不腐蝕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on removing corroded external tendons safely under traffic, restoring prestress and leaving a traceable tendon record; Prestressing-duct grouting centres on grout materials, duct and vent layout, grouting procedure and void detection that keep post-tensioning tendons free of corrosion for decades, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」與「鋼腱有效預力 P_e」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預力混凝土孔道灌漿，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” and “Tendon effective force P_e”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Prestressing-duct grouting, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Grout testing and field mock-ups", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
history.text: 外置鋼腱的預鑄節塊箱梁在 1980 至 1990 年代廣泛用於美國的跨水與高架橋，1993 年通車、長約 5.8 km 的佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋即屬此類。1999 年佛州 Niles Channel 橋出現美國第一起確認由腐蝕造成的鋼腱失效，2000 年 Mid-Bay 大橋接著發現斷裂鋼腱，FDOT 研擬逐股切斷的去張程序並更換 11 條鋼腱；之後 Ringling 堤道橋在 2011 年更換 17 條鋼腱，Wando River 橋在 2016 與 2018 年兩度出現鋼腱失效。這些事件推動了灌漿材料與規範改進、2019 年 FHWA 可更換灌漿外置鋼腱指引，以及 2024 年 FHWA 腐蝕導致鋼腱失效的彙整報告。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Precast segmental box girders with external tendons were widely used for American water crossings and viaducts in the 1980s and 1990s, including Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge, about 5.8 km long and opened in 1993. In 1999 Florida's Niles Channel Bridge had the first confirmed corrosion-caused tendon failure in the United States; in 2000 broken tendons were found at Mid-Bay, where FDOT devised a strand-by-strand detensioning procedure and replaced 11 tendons. Ringling Causeway Bridge later had 17 tendons replaced in 2011, and Wando River Bridge suffered tendon failures in 2016 and 2018. These events drove improved grout materials and specifications, FHWA's 2019 guide to replaceable grouted external tendons and FHWA's 2024 compilation on corrosion-induced tendon failures. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

references.scopeEn: Design guide covering the double-envelope concept, diabolo deviators, minimum radii, stressing clearances and detensioning considerations.

references.title: FDOT：外置預力鋼腱去張（Mid-Bay 大橋案例）
references.titleEn: FDOT: Detensioning an External Prestressing Tendon (Mid-Bay Bridge case)
references.scope: FDOT 工程師記錄 2000 年 Mid-Bay 鋼腱去張的方法比較、切斷順序、夾具與殘餘力估計；不構成作業許可。
references.scopeEn: FDOT engineers' account of detensioning a Mid-Bay tendon in 2000, comparing methods, cutting sequence, clamps and residual-force estimate; not an operating permit.

references.title: FHWA：後拉預力孔道缺陷灌漿取樣、評估與修復指引（FHWA-HRT-13-028）
references.titleEn: FHWA: Guidelines for Sampling, Assessing, and Restoring Defective Grout in Post-Tensioning Ducts (FHWA-HRT-13-028)
references.scope: 灌漿缺陷類型、統計抽樣數量、取樣位置與修復方法的決策流程。
references.scopeEn: Decision process for grout deficiency types, statistically based sample sizes, sampling locations and restoration methods.

references.title: Corven Engineering：Mid-Bay 大橋預力系統評估
references.scope: 顧問公司專案頁，說明 2000 年發現兩條鋼腱失效後的檢測、分析、載重評等與整治項目及橋梁基本資料。
references.scopeEn: Consultant project page describing inspection, analysis, load rating and rehabilitation items after two tendon failures were found in 2000, with basic bridge data.

roles.businessEn: Manages Florida highway bridges and publishes technical documents and research on post-tensioning design, grouting and tendon detensioning.

roles.role: 以臨時預力棒支撐、去張與新鋼腱安裝的專案案例
roles.roleEn: Project example of temporary bar support, detensioning and new-tendon installation

roles.businessEn: Supplies post-tensioning systems, prestressing bars and tendon restoration work, and took part in tendon restoration at the Mid-Bay Bridge.

roles.role: M50.3 與 M55.1 規範對鋼腱與灌漿品質的要求

roles.businessEn: Develops specifications for post-tensioning materials, installation and grouting, and certifies post-tensioning field personnel.
